arStrings.szText: Your direct Lightning damage makes your {c_important}Storm{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|2%x|]{/c} more damage to the enemy, up to {c_random}[(Affix."Static Value 0"*Affix_Value_1")*100|2%x|]{/c}. At maximum stacks, the target becomes {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}.
